description: This is a test source file for the Context class within the OpenMRS API project, containing unit tests for authentication, cache management, user context, and service retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: ContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Context utility in OpenMRS, testing user authentication, session management, caching, and service retrieval.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullPassword
methods.description: Tests that authentication fails when password is null.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullPasswordAndProperSystemId
methods.description: Tests that authentication fails with null password and a valid system ID.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullPasswordAndProperUsername
methods.description: Tests that authentication fails with null password and a valid username.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullUsername
methods.description: Tests that authentication fails when username is null.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Tests that authentication fails with both username and password null.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldAuthenticateUserWithUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Tests successful authentication with valid username and password.

methods.name: getLocale_shouldNotFailIfSessionHasntBeenOpened
methods.description: Ensures getLocale does not fail when session is closed.

methods.name: getUserContext_shouldFailIfSessionHasntBeenOpened
methods.description: Ensures getUserContext throws exception if session is closed.

methods.name: logout_shouldNotFailIfSessionHasntBeenOpenedYet
methods.description: Ensures logout does not fail when session is already closed.

methods.name: isSessionOpen_shouldReturnTrueIfSessionIsClosed
methods.description: Verifies isSessionOpen returns false after session is closed.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser_shouldGetFreshValuesFromTheDatabase
methods.description: Tests that refreshAuthenticatedUser updates the cached user data from database.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser_shouldNotUnsetUserLocation
methods.description: Ensures user location persists after refresh.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser_shouldSetDefaultLocationIfLocationNull
methods.description: Checks default location is set if user location is null after refresh.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponents_shouldReturnAListOfAllRegisteredBeansOfThePassedType
methods.description: Ensures registered components of a specific type are returned.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponents_shouldReturnAnEmptyListIfNoBeansHaveBeenRegisteredOfThePassedType
methods.description: Verifies that an empty list is returned when no beans of type are registered.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponent_shouldReturnBeanHaveBeenRegisteredOfThePassedTypeAndName
methods.description: Retrieves a specific registered component by name and type.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponent_shouldFailIfBeanHaveBeenREgisteredOfThePassedTypeAndNameDoesntExist
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown if a component with given name does not exist.

methods.name: getService_shouldReturnTheSameObjectWhenCalledMultipleTimesForTheSameClass
methods.description: Confirms singleton-like behavior of service retrieval.

methods.name: becomeUser_shouldChangeLocaleWhenBecomeAnotherUser
methods.description: Tests locale change when context switches to another user.

methods.name: evictEntity_shouldClearTheEntityFromCaches
methods.description: Ensures an entity is evicted from cache.

methods.name: evictAllEntities_shouldClearAllEntityFromCaches
methods.description: Ensures all entities of a class are evicted from cache.

methods.name: clearEntireCache_shouldClearEntireCache
methods.description: Verifies that cache clearing works for entire cache.
